evals.prompt: give me the best hashtags for a home fitness niche on instagram
evals.expected_output: Ranked table of 3-8 hashtags mixing big/medium/niche tiers, each backed by a live search result with a source link, ending with an offer to write/swap into a reel-script caption.
assertions: Runs a live web search (loads WebSearch via ToolSearch if not already loaded) rather than answering from memory
Returns a table with columns for hashtag, tier, why/signal, and source
Every row's Source column has an actual site name/link, never blank or invented
Mixes at least one big, one medium, and one niche tag if search surfaces enough variety
Ends by offering to hand off into reel-script or swap into an existing caption

evals.prompt: research hashtags for [an extremely obscure, low-volume niche unlikely to have real hashtag data]
evals.expected_output: Honest statement that hashtag data is thin for this niche, without inventing post-count numbers or fake tags to fill the list.
assertions: Does not fabricate specific post-count/volume numbers when search results are thin or generic
States plainly that hashtag data for the niche is limited
Does not silently pad the list to reach 3-8 tags with invented ones
